notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed. The card's entry symbol genesislab.envs:ManagerBasedRlEnv was confirmed at source/genesislab/genesislab/envs/manager_based_rl_env.py:28, and Genesis-HVelocity-G1-v0 is registered at source/genesis_tasks/genesis_tasks/locomotion/hvelocity/g1/__init__.py:4-13. The upstream class does not expose Gymnasium spaces: action_space is a torch tensor and observation_space is None (source/genesislab/genesislab/envs/manager_based_genesis_env.py:156-165). The package fake therefore supplies an unbounded 29-element placeholder Box and a 99-element placeholder observation so the Gymnasium bridge can shape the vector; this shape is test data, and the driver declares no limits because the action term has no clip (source/genesis_tasks/genesis_tasks/locomotion/hvelocity/components.py:92-96). The F1 fidelity describes the Genesis environment, not the fake; the fake is a deterministic kinematic stand-in with no physics, contacts, actuators, sensors, terrain or noise. The upstream environment (torch, the Genesis engine and the robot assets) was not installed or run, and no hardware was attached. Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it queues the seed; the native call happens on the next reset), G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (no sourced limit to probe), and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs (ticks and seed twice) and the derived action.values (the bridge supplies descriptions but no units; declaring family actions was not used because it exposes reset inputs without descriptions, the known exemplar limitation). No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
